name: circular-seal-lock
intent: A ring of six radial marks rotates from −42° to 0° while a progressive engage stroke fills the rim; twelve index ticks light as the seal locks.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to rotate the ring into alignment.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Ring appears already at 0° LOCKED with engage stroke complete; no rotation

acceptance: Idle ring sits at initialOffsetDeg −42; Run rotates to lockDeg 0 over rotateMs 520
Exactly 12 index ticks (6 major every 60°) and 6 rotating marks; engage stroke dash 327 draws during rotation
On lock, core pulses once for lockPulseMs 150 and major ticks turn vermillion
Replay resets to −42° UNLOCKED before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows LOCKED at 0° immediately with no rotate animation
